Neapolitan Focaccia

Transforming the classic Neapolitan pizza dough into a focaccia, this recipe is adorned with juicy cherry tomatoes and fragrant rosemary, creating a medley of flavors that are both simple and sublime. The light, airy dough serves as the perfect canvas for the sweet tomatoes and aromatic rosemary, resulting in a dish that elegantly bridges the gap between traditional pizza and rustic Italian bread.

Prep

  • Easy
  • Serves: 4
  • Prep Time: 5 mins
  • Cook Time: 2 mins

Ingredients

  • one 250 gram Neapolitan style dough ball
  • a handful of halved cherry tomatoes
  • 1 minced garlic clove
  • 5 grams extra-virgin olive oil
  • 3 sprigs of rosemary
  • a pinch of flaked sea salt

Instructions

Fire up your woodfire pizza oven, aiming for 500 ˚C (930 ˚F) on the pizza stone.

Dust both your work surface and pizza peel with flour to avoid the dough sticking to either.

Stretch the pizza dough ball out to 12 inches and lay it out on your pizza peel.

Add the halved tomatoes. Sprinkle the minced garlic and chopped rosemary leaves evenly. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

Slide the pizza off the peel into your oven and bake for 1 to 2 minutes. Remember to rotate the pizza every 20 seconds to ensure an even bake.

As soon as it looks cooked on all sides, remove and finish with a pinch of flakey sea salt. Enjoy!
